title: Ten For, One Against
subtitle: 领袖政治 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 领袖政治（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）
meta: 主题语境：领袖政治（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）　|　核心词汇：vote　|　正文 388 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vote 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was one ① vote in it, and that is the whole story: eleven people, ten for and one against, and the one against was my grandmother, and she was right, and the road went through anyway, and a vote is not a decision but a count. The ② vote took four minutes and has been remembered for thirty-one years, and she said afterwards that a vote is a way of finding out who was right without anybody having to say so.

She had ③ voted the same way eleven times before and had lost eleven times, and she said the losing was not the point, and I believed her for thirty-one years and do not now. In 1968 she ④ voted against the man everybody else wanted, and he was elected, and he was the one who got the road built, and she said afterwards that she had been right about him too and that it had made no difference.

The ⑤ vote, when it was counted again in 1972, came out eleven to ten the other way, and the road had already been open for a year, and the council said nothing at all. In 1974 they ⑥ put the whole question to the vote a second time, at a meeting eleven people attended, and it was carried, and my grandmother was not there, and she never said whether that had been deliberate.

She got the ⑦ vote in 1928, at twenty-one, walked eleven miles to use it, and used it every time until 1997, which is sixty-nine years and I have checked. In 1997 she ⑧ cast a vote from a chair in the hall, with two people holding the door, and she said it was the last one and that she was glad of it.

The ⑨ vote I remember, and I was eleven, is the 1974 one, because she had told me which way she would go and had been overruled, and because I thought then that losing a vote is the same as being wrong. The ⑩ vote, meaning the thing itself and not the result, was what she cared about, and she said so once in 1989: the road was eleven years of noise, but the meeting was four minutes and everybody had been in the room, and no vote, she said, is ever lost by the person who was right.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 票；选票（一票之差）
B. n. 投票；表决（行为或过程）
C. n. 选举权；投票权
D. n. 得票结果；票数
F. 固定搭配：vote for / against ... 投票支持／反对……
G. 固定搭配：put ... to the vote 把……付诸表决
H. 固定搭配：cast a vote 投一票；投票

items.q: There was one vote in it
She had voted the same way eleven times
The vote, when it was counted again
they put the whole question to the vote
she cast a vote from a chair
The vote I remember, and I was eleven
The vote, meaning the thing itself

answers.why: one vote 意为“一票”，事情就差一票：十票赞成，一票反对，反对的那一票是我祖母投的。
the vote 意为“（那次）投票、表决”，那次表决只用了四分钟，却被记住了三十一年。
voted 是动词，意为“投票、表决”，此前她以同样的方式投过十一次票，也输过十一次。
vote against ... 意为“投票反对……”，1968 年她投票反对了大家都想要的那个人。
the vote 意为“得票结果、票数”，1972 年重新点票时，结果是十一比十，方向反了过来。
put ... to the vote 意为“把……付诸表决”，1974 年他们第二次把整个问题付诸表决。
the vote 意为“选举权、投票权”，她 1928 年二十一岁时获得了选举权，走了十一英里去投票。
cast a vote 意为“投一票”，1997 年她坐在大厅的椅子上投了最后一票。
the vote 意为“那一次投票、那一票”，我记得的是 1974 年那一次投票。
the vote 意为“投票这件事本身”，她在意的不是结果，而是投票本身这件事。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 事情就差一票：十票赞成，一票反对，而反对的那一票是她投的。（vote）
那次表决只用了四分钟，却被记住了三十一年。（vote）
1968 年她投票反对了大家都想要的那个人，而那个人当选了。（vote against）
1972 年重新点票时，结果是十一比十，方向反了过来。（vote）
1974 年他们第二次把整个问题付诸表决，只有十一个人到场。（put ... to the vote）
她 1928 年获得选举权，此后每次都投票，直到 1997 年。（the vote）
answers: There was one vote in it: ten for and one against, and the one against was hers.
The vote took four minutes and has been remembered for thirty-one years.
In 1968 she voted against the man everybody else wanted, and he was elected.
The vote, when it was counted again in 1972, came out eleven to ten the other way.
In 1974 they put the whole question to the vote a second time, at a meeting eleven people attended.
She got the vote in 1928 and used it every time until 1997.
